title: Prove Me Wrong: choose a serious, premium world
question: Three calm, finance-credible directions (no handwriting, no texture), plus the category standard. Pick one, or re-roll.

options.label: Private Client Report
options.lineage: Private-banking quarterly statements: the document a wealth manager hands a client
options.thesis: Your thesis is presented like a private-bank statement: each sentence carries evidence in 'For' and 'Against' columns and a net balance.
options.viewport: A navy left rail (search, Thesis, Scoreboard). White work area with the company, last close and a primary 'Test my thesis' button. A three-row statement: sentence | For | Against | net verdict. The cited evidence opens in a right panel.
options.risk: Without the For/Against balance done with real precision, it slides into a generic bank portal.

options.label: Equity Research Note
options.lineage: Swiss-style sell-side research notes: strict grid, a key-data table, a rating box on page one
options.thesis: Every thesis comes back as a one-page research note on you: the usual rating box becomes a Verdict box per sentence, set on a strict grid with big, exact figures.
options.viewport: A slim top bar (search, Scoreboard, How it works). The headline is the company name with key data in a right sidebar (close, range, volatility, regime). Below are three verdict rows, each with a sentence, its verdict chip, and one line of evidence.
options.risk: Can feel austere and document-like if the grid and type scale aren't executed with confidence.

options.label: Reference Ranges
options.lineage: Premium diagnostic reports: every value shown against its normal range, flagged when outside it
options.thesis: Each signal is read the way a doctor reads bloodwork: today's value sits on its normal-range bar (the baseline) and is flagged when it's outside, so you see at a glance what's unusual.
options.viewport: A left rail and a header with the stock and a Test button. Thesis rows show their verdicts. Below, a 'Results' table: signal | today | reference range bar | flag | model track record.
options.risk: Medical connotations could feel odd for finance; it has to stay finance-first, and the range bar does the work.

canonCard.label: The category standard, done impeccably
canonCard.thesis: A clean research dashboard at the craft level of Koyfin, Linear or Stripe's dashboard: neutral, precise, quietly confident.
canonCard.viewport: A sidebar, the stock header, the thesis panel with verdict chips, and signal cards below.
canonCard.risk: Polished but forgettable: it will look like many AI-built dashboards.
